quests.title: Returns at Bella Vista
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. I am sending back 74 papers a day from Bella Vista and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Bella Vista
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. They will drop my Bella Vista order if I can show $114 of turnover on the other side of the shop by a public holiday nobody remembered. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: $114, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Bella Vista Round
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. I do the Bella Vista round from the second express and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Bella Vista
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. There is a dog on the Bella Vista round that has had two of my bags and a laminated notice that was not even mine. This is the third time I have had this conversation. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Bella Vista
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Nine of us at Bella Vista have gone in on the same numbers since a public holiday nobody remembered and one of us has stopped putting money in. It started small, the way these things do. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$74, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Bella Vista
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The agency at Norwest closed six months before Bella Vista started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me

quests.title: The Unclaimed Falcon, Glenfield
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. There has been a car in the Glenfield yard since every second Friday with a esky of warm cans on the passenger seat and no owner answering. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the car and the plate together
I have to prove I tried before I can move it

quests.title: Storage Fees, Glenfield
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Now that it is documented, Glenfield is owed $169 in storage and the only person who can pay it is the person not answering. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: $169, from him or from the scrap
either way it comes off my floor

quests.title: First Year, Glenfield
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. I am in my first year at Glenfield and I have to log 61 hours on a job I am not allowed to touch on my own. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the supplier, two streets over
and get him a coffee, it helps

quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. Somebody has been coming into the Glenfield yard after quarter to six to use the air line, and last week they used the compressor as well. This is the third time I have had this conversation. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the ones who think the yard is public
the gate they are getting through

quests.title: My Own Car, Glenfield
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. My car has been at Glenfield since every second Friday and every time I ring, the quote has grown by about $61. It started small, the way these things do. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: stand in the office where they can see you
the job card on the wall, all of it

steps.label: catch him before he goes out on the road
I want to hear how he does it

quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. People leave things at the Mortdale roller door after quarter to six and by morning it is rained on and it is our problem and our tip fee. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I'll see you right for it.

the council will not act without one of these

quests.title: The Tip Fee, Mortdale
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

quests.title: The Good Box, Mortdale
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Something came into Mortdale on the Sunday after payday in a box of paperbacks that I do not think the family meant to give away. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Just do not come back empty-handed.

the thing itself, before it goes back

quests.title: Head Office, Mortdale
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Everything Mortdale cannot sell goes to a warehouse at Oatley, and nobody there has ever answered a phone in my hearing. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Do not make a scene about it.
